To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- All records, including main files and cross-references, concerning Robert K. Brown (born Nov. 2, 1932, in Monroe, Michigan; died Aug. 28, 2026), founder of Soldier of Fortune magazine, between Jan. 1, 1950, and the present, from FBI Headquarters and all field offices, including the Denver Field Office, including the following words/phrases: "Robert K. Brown," "Bob Brown," "Soldier of Fortune," "Omega Group," "Paladin Press"
- All electronic surveillance (ELSUR) index records concerning Robert K. Brown between Jan. 1, 1950, and the present, from FBI Headquarters and all field offices

Mr. Brown is deceased. Proof of death is attached and available at the following links:
https://sofmag.com/martin-kufus-memoir-robert-k-brown/
https://dailycaller.com/2026/11/03/robert-k-brown-journalist-and-rowdy-advocate-for-second-amendment-veterans-passes-away-at-93/

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the FOIA requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, NRS Chapter 239, I request the following records concerning reported bedbug infestations at hotels and motels within Reno, Nevada, from January 1, 2024, through the date this request is processed:

All complaints reporting suspected or confirmed bedbugs at hotels and motels, including the property name, address and complaint date. Complainants’ personal identifying information may be redacted.

All inspection reports, investigation findings and photographs associated with these complaints, including records indicating whether an infestation was confirmed.

All notices of violation, corrective action requirements, room closure orders and other enforcement records related to bedbugs.

All follow-up inspection reports and records documenting treatment or other corrective actions submitted by the affected properties.

This request concerns existing records only. If another agency maintains these records, please identify that agency and provide its contact information, if available.

I am a journalism student at the University of Nevada, Reno, conducting noncommercial research. Please notify me of any anticipated fees before incurring costs. I do not authorize fees without prior approval.

Please fulfill this request electronically, preferably as searchable PDFs, with existing spreadsheets provided in their original electronic format.

If any portion of a record is exempt from disclosure, please release all nonexempt portions and identify the legal basis for each withholding.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to receiving your response within the timeframe provided by law.

Sincerely,

Olivia Green

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

olivia green

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552, I hereby request the following records concerning testing of products marketed or labeled as BPC-157, TB-500, CJC-1295, ipamorelin, or retatrutide, including products sold online as “research use only.”

Please provide the following records dated January 1, 2025, through the date this request is processed:

Final laboratory reports and analytical testing results for these products tested by the FDA or laboratories acting on its behalf, including results concerning identity, purity, potency, actual peptide content, contamination, sterility, and bacterial endotoxins.

Certificates of analysis and third-party laboratory testing reports for these products submitted to or obtained by the FDA during inspections, investigations, or product sampling.

Records accompanying these results that identify the manufacturer, distributor, or seller; product name; batch or lot number; labeled quantity; sample collection date; testing date; and laboratory performing the analysis.

Final findings, notices, or correspondence sent to the relevant companies concerning testing results that showed contamination, incorrect ingredients, or differences between labeled and measured peptide content.

This request seeks existing records only and does not ask the agency to conduct new testing or create an analysis. If any portion of a record is exempt from disclosure, please release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions and identify the legal basis for each withholding.

I am a journalism student at the University of Nevada, Reno, conducting noncommercial journalistic research concerning peptide product quality and regulatory oversight. Please consider this purpose when determining the applicable fee category. Please notify me of any anticipated fees before incurring costs; I do not authorize fees without prior approval.

Please fulfill this request electronically, preferably as searchable PDFs, with any existing spreadsheets provided in their original electronic format.

If clarification would help locate responsive records or reduce processing time, please contact me before closing the request.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your response within the timeframe provided by law.

Sincerely,

Olivia Green

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

olivia green
